roadmap.title: Space Rig routine
roadmap.description: Clear the Space Rig's side content between missions: the Barrel Hoop minigame, the Abyss Bar, the jukebox, barrel physics, and the cosmetics shop. None of it needs mission progress.

roadmap.title: Build the career
roadmap.description: Play missions to advance: finish the first assignment, climb Hazard Levels 3-5 including no-down and no-resupply runs, bank Milestones and Perks, promote dwarves, unlock weapons and mods, and build up solo, hosted-team, and mentored mission counts.

roadmap.title: In-mission work
roadmap.description: Complete mission-specific counters and encounters: weakspot hits, Dreadnoughts, Bulk Detonators, BET-C, Mini M.U.L.E.s, gems and Error Cubes, creature rides, the Drilldozer, and pipeline grinding.

roadmap.title: Deep Dives
roadmap.description: Finish the weekly Deep Dive chain: one normal Deep Dive, one Elite Deep Dive, five total, and a run under 45 minutes.

achievements.description: Complete your first assignment.
achievements.summary: Finish every mission in the first assignment you accept on the Space Rig.

steps.text: Open the @loc{Assignment Terminal} on the @loc{Space Rig} and accept the assignment offered to a new miner.
Complete each mission the assignment lists; the active mission is marked on the mission map by a diagonal square.

achievements.displayName: If Only I Got Paid For This...
achievements.description: In the Barrel Hoop game, achieve a score of 3000 or more in less than 100 kicks.
achievements.summary: Reach 3000 points in the Space Rig @mechanic{Barrel Hoop} minigame in fewer than 100 kicks.

guide.context: The hoop resets its speed only at the left end of its travel, so kicks timed while it moves right to left stay predictable.

steps.text: Wait until the @mechanic{Barrel Hoop} has slowed to its minimum speed before starting.
Kick each @item{barrel} through the hoop while it travels right to left; consecutive hits raise the score multiplier.
Hold one chain long enough to pass 3000 points within 100 kicks.
steps.note: When the hoop becomes too fast to time, stop kicking and wait for it to slow again; the old chain is gone either way, and a fresh run of hits still reaches the target.

achievements.description: Kick ten barrels into the Space Rig barrel hoop without missing.
achievements.summary: Kick ten barrels into the Space Rig @mechanic{Barrel Hoop} without a miss.

steps.text: Kick @item{barrels} through the @mechanic{Barrel Hoop} ten times in a row.

achievements.displayName: That's Not How You Play This Game
achievements.description: Throw a beer mug into the Space Rig barrel hoop.
achievements.summary: Throw a beer mug into the Space Rig @mechanic{Barrel Hoop}.

steps.text: Buy a @item{beer} at the @loc{Abyss Bar} and throw the mug through the @mechanic{Barrel Hoop}; standing directly below the hoop makes the throw easiest.

achievements.description: Jump through the Space Rig barrel hoop while intoxicated.
achievements.summary: Jump through the Space Rig @mechanic{Barrel Hoop} while drunk.

steps.text: Drink @item{beer} at the @loc{Abyss Bar} until you are intoxicated, then jump through the @mechanic{Barrel Hoop}.

achievements.description: Spend an hour dancing on the Space Rig.
achievements.summary: Dance on the @loc{Space Rig} for one hour in total.

steps.text: Dance on the @loc{Space Rig} until the total dancing time passes one hour.
steps.note: The target is 3600 seconds on the Dancing Time stat; progress shows in your Steam profile under this game's stats and leaderboards.

achievements.description: Pay for 25 rounds at the Abyss Bar.
achievements.summary: Pay for 25 rounds of drinks at the @loc{Abyss Bar}.

guide.context: Three brews cost credits only and need no license: Leaf Lover's Special, Glyphid Slammer, and Oily Oaf Brew.

steps.text: Order drinks at the @loc{Abyss Bar} until you have paid for 25 rounds.

achievements.description: Toast with a full team while jukebox music plays.
achievements.summary: In a full team of four, salute while dancing to @loc{jukebox} music with everyone holding a beer.

guide.context: The salute must land at the same moment from all four dwarves; if anyone drinks their beer first, the attempt fails.

steps.text: Gather four dwarves on the @loc{Space Rig} and have everyone buy a @item{beer} at the @loc{Abyss Bar}.
Start music at the @loc{jukebox} and have all four dwarves dance.
Salute together so all four dwarves Rock and Stone at the same moment while still holding their beer.
steps.note: The timing window is tight, so retry until one attempt lands.

achievements.description: Play 25 jukebox songs to the end.
achievements.summary: Play 25 songs on the @loc{Space Rig} jukebox to the end.

steps.text: Queue songs at the @loc{jukebox} opposite the @loc{Abyss Bar} and let each one finish playing; interrupted songs do not count.

achievements.description: Ride a barrel in the spacerig for three seconds.
achievements.summary: Ride a Space Rig barrel for three seconds.

steps.text: Kick a @item{barrel} into a corner or another tight spot so it stays put.
Jump on and stay on the barrel for three seconds.
steps.note: Barrels are steadier when you host than in someone else's lobby.

achievements.description: Place a barrel in every seat of the Drop Pod.
achievements.summary: Put a @item{barrel} in every seat of the @loc{Drop Pod}.

steps.text: Kick barrels up the ladder into the @loc{Drop Pod}.
Press one barrel deep into each seat so it cannot roll back out.

achievements.description: Load every Space Rig barrel into the Drop Pod.
achievements.summary: Stuff every Space Rig barrel into the @loc{Drop Pod}.

guide.context: Loose barrels sometimes vanish while you work, so a disappeared barrel can force a fresh start.

steps.text: Kick every barrel you find on the @loc{Space Rig} up into the @loc{Drop Pod}.
If a barrel drops into the Launch Bay, bring it back up with the ladder or through the wall opening.

achievements.displayName: Foreign Objects In The Launch Bay
achievements.description: Kick every Space Rig barrel into the Launch Bay.
achievements.summary: Kick every Space Rig barrel into the Launch Bay under the @loc{Drop Pod}.

guide.context: This cannot be combined with the Drop Pod barrel run; barrels inside the pod do not count as being in the Launch Bay.

steps.text: Kick every barrel on the @loc{Space Rig} down into the Launch Bay so each one lands on the force field under the @loc{Drop Pod}.

achievements.description: Play ten missions in a row without kicking a barrel on the Space Rig.
achievements.summary: Play ten missions in a row without kicking a barrel on the @loc{Space Rig}.

steps.text: Complete ten missions back to back and leave every Space Rig barrel untouched between them.

achievements.description: Fix 50 Mini M.U.L.E.s.
achievements.summary: Repair 50 broken Mini M.U.L.E.s during Salvage Operation missions.

guide.context: Every dwarf who is repairing a Mini M.U.L.E. when it comes back online earns credit, so the whole team can work on one unit.

steps.text: Select Salvage Operation missions, where broken Mini M.U.L.E.s lie in the caves.
Repair each Mini M.U.L.E. you find and keep running the mission type until 50 are fixed.

achievements.description: Defeat and fix a BET-C.
achievements.summary: Defeat a BET-C, then re-enable it.

guide.context: A BET-C reveals itself with a loud pulsing signal, and its Xynarch Charge-Suckers are the only weak points.

steps.text: Follow the pulsing sound through the cave to find the @enemy{BET-C}.
Destroy the @item{Xynarch Charge-Suckers} on its flanks to disable it.
Interact with the disabled machine to repair it; it then fights for your team.

achievements.description: Land 1000 weakspot hits.
achievements.summary: Land 1000 weakspot hits.

steps.text: Shoot glowing or exposed body parts such as mouths and abdomens across your missions until the counter reaches 1000.

achievements.description: Participate in killing 40 Dreadnoughts.
achievements.summary: Take part in killing 40 Dreadnoughts.

guide.context: Elimination missions are the main source, and a Dreadnought can also replace a normal swarm in other mission types.

steps.text: Run Elimination missions and break every Dreadnought cocoon you find.
steps.note: The counter covers the standard Glyphid Dreadnought, the Arbalest and Lacerator Twins, and the Hiveguard.

achievements.description: Participate in killing 20 Bulk Detonators.
achievements.summary: Take part in killing 20 Bulk Detonators.

steps.text: Shoot the glowing sacs on a @enemy{Bulk Detonator}'s back for critical damage and take part in 20 kills.

achievements.description: Participate in killing two Dreadnoughts within five minutes on Hazard Level 3 or higher.
achievements.summary: Take part in killing two Dreadnoughts less than five minutes apart on Hazard Level 3 or higher.

guide.context: Both kills must happen inside the same Elimination mission, and knowing the route between the two cocoons ahead of time saves minutes.

steps.text: Start an Elimination mission on @mechanic{Hazard Level 3} or higher.
Break the first cocoon, kill its @enemy{Dreadnought}, then reach and kill the second before five minutes pass.

achievements.description: Participate in killing two Dreadnoughts within 30 seconds on Hazard Level 3 or higher.
achievements.summary: Take part in killing two Dreadnoughts less than 30 seconds apart on Hazard Level 3 or higher.

guide.context: Both kills must land in the same mission, and each dwarf needs damage on both targets for their participation to count.

steps.text: Start an Elimination mission on @mechanic{Hazard Level 3} or higher and open two Dreadnought cocoons before the fights begin.
Damage both Dreadnoughts down to low health without killing either, making sure every dwarf has hit both.
Finish both Dreadnoughts inside one 30-second window.
steps.note: Two or more players make this far easier.

achievements.description: Collect 10 Bittergems.
achievements.summary: Collect 10 Bittergems.

steps.text: Mine the small purple shards that glow on cave floors and deposit 10 @item{Bittergems}.

achievements.description: Collect 20 Compressed Gold Chunks.
achievements.summary: Collect 20 Compressed Gold chunks.

steps.text: Mine the small gold chunks poking out of the ground with a yellow glow and deposit 20 of them.

achievements.description: Deposit five Error Cubes.
achievements.summary: Deposit five Error Cubes.

guide.context: Error Cubes are extremely rare, so treat every one you spot as worth mining.

steps.text: Look for a cube sitting among grey pulsating spikes with a purple glow.
Mine the @item{Error Cube} and deposit five of them across your missions.

achievements.description: Ride Molly for 15 seconds.
achievements.summary: Ride Molly the M.U.L.E. for 15 seconds.

steps.text: After the primary objective is done, climb on Molly as she walks to the @loc{Drop Pod} and stay on for 15 seconds.

achievements.description: Ride the Silicate Harvester for 30 seconds.
achievements.summary: Ride a Silicate Harvester for 30 seconds.

guide.context: The passive Silicate Harvester appears in the Radioactive Exclusion Zone, Fungus Bogs, and Dense Biozone.

steps.text: Find a @enemy{Silicate Harvester} and stay on its back for 30 seconds.

achievements.description: Ride the Silicate Harvester with three other dwarves and kill five enemies each without leaving.
achievements.summary: Ride a Silicate Harvester with a full team and have each dwarf kill five enemies without leaving.

guide.context: Each dwarf needs five kills of their own, and explosives can kill the harvester and end the attempt for everyone.

steps.text: Gather four dwarves and have everyone ride the same @enemy{Silicate Harvester}.
Stir up a @enemy{Glyphid Swarmer} nest so enemies come near the harvester.
Kill five enemies on each dwarf without anyone stepping off.

achievements.description: Take the most Dreadnought damage in your team.
achievements.summary: Take the most Dreadnought damage in your team during one fight.

steps.text: Absorb more damage from an @enemy{Dreadnought} than any teammate across a single fight.
steps.note: Getting downed before the Dreadnought dies voids the credit.

achievements.description: Be the last dwarf standing with empty weapons when a Dreadnought spawns.
achievements.summary: Stand as the last dwarf with both weapons empty when a Dreadnought spawns.

guide.context: A solo Elimination mission makes you the last dwarf standing automatically.

steps.text: Start a solo Elimination mission and empty the ammo of your primary and secondary weapons.
Break a Dreadnought cocoon using only your pickaxe.
steps.note: If nothing unlocks, empty your support, utility, and grenade ammo as well, and disable @npc{Bosco} from its terminal before starting a fresh attempt.

achievements.description: Stay in one mission for an hour or longer.
achievements.summary: Stay in one mission for one hour or longer.

steps.text: Start any mission and remain in it for a full hour without extracting.
steps.note: The unlock fires as soon as the hour passes.

achievements.description: Complete your first mission.
achievements.summary: Finish any mission for the first time.

steps.text: Pick a mission at the @loc{Mission Select terminal} and launch it.
Complete at least the primary objective and ride the @loc{Drop Pod} home.

achievements.description: Complete 100 missions.
achievements.summary: Complete 100 missions.

steps.text: Play missions of any type to completion until the career counter reaches 100.

achievements.description: Complete 500 missions.
achievements.summary: Complete 500 missions.

steps.text: Keep completing missions of any type until the career counter reaches 500.

achievements.description: Survive a Hazard Level 3 mission from start to finish.
achievements.summary: Clear a Hazard Level 3 mission start to finish.

steps.text: Set the hazard level to 3 when confirming any mission and finish it.

achievements.description: Successfully complete three Hazard Level 3 missions from start to finish in a row.
achievements.summary: Complete three Hazard Level 3 missions in a row.

steps.text: Finish three @mechanic{Hazard Level 3} missions back to back.
steps.note: Do not drop to a lower hazard between them.

achievements.description: Survive a Hazard Level 4 mission from start to finish.
achievements.summary: Clear a Hazard Level 4 mission start to finish.

guide.context: Two or three players make the run noticeably easier than a full squad.

steps.text: Set the hazard level to 4 when confirming a mission and finish it.

achievements.description: Successfully complete four Hazard Level 4 missions from start to finish in a row.
achievements.summary: Complete four Hazard Level 4 missions in a row.

steps.text: Finish four @mechanic{Hazard Level 4} missions back to back.
steps.note: Do not drop to a lower hazard between them.

achievements.description: Successfully complete a Hazard Level 5 mission from start to finish.
achievements.summary: Clear a Hazard Level 5 mission start to finish.

guide.context: Promoted dwarves and a two-player team are the recommended setup.

steps.text: Set the hazard level to 5 when confirming a mission and finish it.

achievements.description: Successfully complete five Hazard Level 5 missions from start to finish in a row.
achievements.summary: Complete five Hazard Level 5 missions in a row.

guide.context: Play the five runs back to back without dropping to a lower hazard level in between.

steps.text: Finish five @mechanic{Hazard Level 5} missions in a row.

achievements.description: Successfully complete a Hazard Level 3 mission from start to finish where no dwarf goes down and without ordering a resupply.
achievements.summary: Finish a Hazard Level 3 mission with no dwarf downed and no resupply ordered.

steps.text: Start a @mechanic{Hazard Level 3} mission and rush the primary objective to keep the run short.
Reach extraction without any dwarf going down and without ordering a @item{Resupply Pod}.

achievements.description: Successfully complete a Hazard Level 4 mission from start to finish where no dwarf goes down and without ordering a resupply.
achievements.summary: Finish a Hazard Level 4 mission with no dwarf downed and no resupply ordered.

steps.text: Start a @mechanic{Hazard Level 4} mission and skip the secondary objectives.
Complete the run without any dwarf going down and without ordering a @item{Resupply Pod}.

achievements.description: Successfully complete a Hazard Level 5 mission from start to finish where no dwarf goes down and without ordering a resupply.
achievements.summary: Finish a Hazard Level 5 mission with no dwarf downed and no resupply ordered.

guide.context: The most reliable setup is two promoted Gunners with shield generators on the shortest Mining Expedition at low cave complexity and length; @item{Dark Morkite} from the @loc{Abyss Bar} helps when it is available.

steps.text: Take a Mining Expedition at Hazard 5 with the shortest length and lowest cave complexity, and mine Morkite only.
steps.note: Expect to restart several times while fishing for a clean cave.

steps.text: Ignore secondary objectives and Nitra, and keep the run free of downs and resupply orders.
Fill the Morkite quota and press the return button on the @loc{M.U.L.E.} before the first swarm lands, roughly five to six minutes in.
Run to the @loc{Drop Pod}; when a swarm chases you, drop a shield generator in a narrow passage so the bugs stay behind.

achievements.description: Successfully complete 20 missions tagged with Warnings from start to finish.
achievements.summary: Complete 20 missions that carry a Warning mutator.

guide.context: Warnings are the red markers on mission select; every Warning counts, and each one adds a hazard bonus.

steps.text: Pick missions tagged with a red @mechanic{Warning} and finish 20 of them.

achievements.description: Host and complete 50 team missions.
achievements.summary: Host and finish 50 team missions.

guide.context: Only the host receives credit; joining someone else's team mission does not count.

steps.text: Open your own lobby and complete 50 missions with a team.

achievements.description: Successfully complete 25 missions where at least 1 player is 10 player ranks lower than you.
achievements.summary: Complete 25 missions with a player at least 10 player ranks below you.

guide.context: Player rank is the account-wide level, so a brand-new save in the squad satisfies the rank gap, and public lobbies count.

steps.text: Squad up with a player at least 10 player ranks below you and complete 25 missions together.

achievements.description: Complete 10 solo missions.
achievements.summary: Complete 10 missions launched with the Solo option.

guide.context: Only the @mechanic{Solo} option counts; hosting a private lobby alone and solo Deep Dives do not.

steps.text: Choose the @mechanic{Solo} option at mission select ten times and finish each run.

achievements.description: Complete 100 solo missions.
achievements.summary: Complete 100 missions launched with the Solo option.

guide.context: Only missions started with the @mechanic{Solo} option count; hosting a private lobby alone and solo Deep Dives do not.

steps.text: Keep choosing the @mechanic{Solo} option and finish 100 runs.

achievements.description: Complete 10 Milestones.
achievements.summary: Complete 10 Milestones.

guide.context: Milestones are listed at the terminal in your sleeping quarters and award perk points when completed.

steps.text: Complete 10 @mechanic{Milestones} and collect the perk points at the sleeping-quarters terminal.

achievements.description: Complete 25 Milestones.
achievements.summary: Complete 25 Milestones.

steps.text: Keep completing @mechanic{Milestones} from the sleeping-quarters terminal until 25 are done.

achievements.description: Unlock 10 Perk Nodes.
achievements.summary: Unlock 10 Perk Nodes.

guide.context: Perk Nodes are purchased with perk points earned from Milestones.

steps.text: Spend perk points on 10 nodes in the perk tree at the sleeping-quarters terminal.

achievements.description: Promote any Dwarf at least once.
achievements.summary: Promote one dwarf.

guide.context: Promotion opens at class level 25 and needs that dwarf's promotion assignment; the assignment missions can be played on any class.

steps.text: Level one class to 25.
steps.note: Double XP, higher hazards, Warnings, and longer missions speed up class XP.

steps.text: Complete the promotion assignment offered at the @loc{Assignment Terminal}.
Promote the dwarf at the character selection terminal.

achievements.description: Promote any two Dwarves at least once.
achievements.summary: Promote two different dwarves at least once each.

steps.text: Repeat the level-25 promotion routine until two classes have been promoted.

achievements.description: Promote any three Dwarves at least once.
achievements.summary: Promote three different dwarves at least once each.

steps.text: Repeat the level-25 promotion routine until three classes have been promoted.

achievements.description: Promote all four Dwarves at least once.
achievements.summary: Promote each of the four classes once.

steps.text: Repeat the level-25 promotion routine until every class has been promoted.

achievements.description: Earn a Silver promotion.
achievements.summary: Earn a Silver promotion on any dwarf.

guide.context: Silver is the fourth promotion on a single class, so the dwarf must finish four level-25 promotion cycles.

steps.text: Promote one dwarf four times.

achievements.description: Earn a Gold promotion.
achievements.summary: Earn a Gold promotion on any dwarf.

guide.context: Gold is the seventh promotion on a single class.

steps.text: Promote one dwarf seven times.

achievements.description: Earn Silver Promotions for all four dwarves.
achievements.summary: Earn a Silver promotion on every one of the four classes.

steps.text: Promote every class four times.

achievements.description: Earn Gold Promotions for all four dwarves.
achievements.summary: Earn a Gold promotion on every one of the four classes.

steps.text: Promote every class seven times.

achievements.description: Unlock a new primary and secondary weapon for one character.
achievements.summary: Unlock one new primary and one new secondary weapon on the same character.

steps.text: Reach class level 10 and complete the primary weapon license assignment at the @loc{Assignment Terminal}.
Reach class level 15 and complete the secondary weapon license assignment for the same class.

achievements.description: Fill every mod tier of one of each upgradable item on a single character.
achievements.summary: Fill every mod tier of one item from each upgradable category on a single character.

steps.text: At the @loc{Equipment Terminal}, purchase all mod tiers for one primary, one secondary, the pickaxe, one support tool, one utility item, and the armor rig of the same character.

achievements.description: Fill every mod tier for Bosco.
achievements.summary: Fill every mod tier for @npc{Bosco}.

steps.text: Open the @loc{Drone Modification terminal} and buy every mod tier for @npc{Bosco}.

achievements.description: Purchase five moustaches for one character.
achievements.summary: Buy five moustaches for one character.

steps.text: Purchase five @item{moustaches} for the same character from the @loc{Shop}.

achievements.description: Customize each accessory slot of a character.
achievements.summary: Equip an item in every accessory slot of one character.

guide.context: The ten slots are eyebrows, sideburns, moustache, beard, hair color, headwear, armor, paintjob, skin color, and victory move.

steps.text: Buy an item for each slot from the @loc{Shop}.
Equip each purchase from the @loc{Wardrobe}; items bought in the shop are not equipped automatically.

achievements.description: Complete A Deep Dive
achievements.summary: Complete a Deep Dive.

guide.context: A Deep Dive chains three missions back to back at Hazard 3, 3.5, and 3.5, with ammo and mined Nitra carrying over between stages.

steps.text: Launch the weekly Deep Dive from the @loc{Deep Dive terminal} on the @loc{Space Rig}.
Finish all three stages, carrying enough ammo into each one because supplies persist.

achievements.description: Complete An Elite Deep Dive
achievements.summary: Complete an Elite Deep Dive.

guide.context: An Elite Deep Dive runs three stages that climb from Hazard 4.5 to 5.5, and only one is available each week.

steps.text: Launch the weekly @mechanic{Elite Deep Dive} from the Deep Dive terminal.
Mine all the Nitra you can and finish all three stages; active perks and @npc{Bosco} revives reset between stages, so use them freely.

achievements.description: Complete Any Deep Dive Under 45 Minutes
achievements.summary: Finish a Deep Dive in under 45 minutes.

guide.context: Solo dives are usually faster because fewer enemies spawn and resupplies are not shared.

steps.text: Start any @mechanic{Deep Dive} and work only on objectives, mining easy Nitra along the way.
Clear all three stages within 45 minutes total.
steps.note: If this week's dive is too slow, the next weekly seed offers a fresh attempt.

achievements.description: Complete Any 5 Deep Dives
achievements.summary: Complete five Deep Dives.

guide.context: Each week offers one normal Dive and one Elite Dive; both types count toward the five.

steps.text: Finish five complete @mechanic{Deep Dives} across as many weeks as needed.

achievements.description: Ride the Drilldozer with three other dwarves and kill 15 enemies each without leaving.
achievements.summary: With three other dwarves aboard, ride the Drilldozer and have each dwarf kill 15 enemies without leaving.

guide.context: Each dwarf's 15 kills are counted separately, and only dwarves who reach the number receive the achievement.

steps.text: Start an @mechanic{Escort Duty} mission with a full team of four and have everyone ride the @loc{Drilldozer}.
Kill 15 enemies on each dwarf without anyone leaving the Drilldozer.
steps.note: The swarms that trigger every time the Drilldozer starts moving are the best opportunity.

achievements.description: Grind on a pipe for 120 seconds without stopping.
achievements.summary: Grind along a pipeline for 120 seconds without stopping.

guide.context: Pipes are built in On-Site Refining missions and have no known length limit, but a pipe that has been connected to a Morkite well can no longer be extended.

steps.text: In an @mechanic{On-Site Refining} mission, build the full pipeline as a long spiral through a wide-open cave such as @loc{Sandblasted Corridors}, using Engineer platforms along the walls to stretch it out.
Ride the pipe for two minutes straight without jumping off.
steps.note: Speed builds on downhill slopes, so aim for a long descending stretch.
